Why then, I repeat it, do I hunger in its hunger, thirst with its thirst, warm under its sun, freeze under its cold, grieve under its sorrows?

63793-little-helpers.title: Little Helpers
63793-little-helpers.creator: Margaret Vandegrift
63793-little-helpers.description: A book by Margaret Vandegrift. “I’ve the greatest mind in the world to drop my new ‘Webster’s Unabridged’ on your head, you wild Indian,” said Mrs. Leslie, holding the big dictionary threateningly, over the edge of the window-sill, and Johnny’s head. “Don’t you suppose I have any inalienable rights? And do you think I can even pursue my happiness, much less catch it, with all this hullaballoo under my window when I am trying to write a letter?”

arxiv-1708-01392.title: Phonon antibunching effect in coupled nonlinear micro/nanomechanical resonator at finite temperature
arxiv-1708-01392.creator: Shengguo Guan 1, Warwick P. Bowen 2, Cunjin Liu 1, and Zhenglu Duan 1a
arxiv-1708-01392.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the phonon antibunching effect in a coupled nonlinear micro/nanoelectromechanical system (MEMS/NEMS) resonator at a finite temperature. In the weak driving limit, the optimal condition for phonon antibunching is given by solving the stationary Liouville-Von Neumann master equation.

arxiv-2105-00865.title: LiveStyle - An Application to Transfer Artistic Styles
arxiv-2105-00865.creator: Amogh G. Warkhandkar Vidyalankar Institute of Technology Mumbai, Maharashtra, India amoghw2025@gmail.com, Omkar B. Bhambure Vidyalankar Institute of Technology Mumbai, Maharashtra, India omieblablablu2996@gmail.com
arxiv-2105-00865.description: Abstract Art is a variety of human activities that include the production of visual, auditory, or performing objects that express the creativity, creative concepts, or technological abilities of the artist, intended primarily for their beauty or emotional power to be appreciated. The renaissance of historic and forgotten art has been made possible by modern developments in Artificial Intelligence.

arxiv-2205-02859.title: Flat-band-based multifractality in the all-bands-flat diamond chain
arxiv-2205-02859.creator: Aamna Ahmed, Ajith Ramachandran, Ivan M. Khaymovich, Auditya Sharma
arxiv-2205-02859.description: Abstract We study the effect of quasiperiodic Aubry-André disorder on the energy spectrum and eigenstates of a one-dimensional all-bands-flat (ABF) diamond chain. The ABF diamond chain possesses three dispersionless flat bands with all the eigenstates compactly localized on two unit cells in the zero disorder limit.

arxiv-2210-17491.title: Learning Modular Robot Locomotion from Demonstrations
arxiv-2210-17491.creator: Julian Whitman, Howie Choset
arxiv-2210-17491.description: Abstract Modular robots can be reconfigured to create a variety of designs from a small set of components. But constructing a robot’s hardware on its own is not enough– each robot needs a controller. One could create controllers for some designs individually, but developing policies for additional designs can be time consuming.

arxiv-2312-00052.title: A Case for Competent AI Systems − - A Concept Note
arxiv-2312-00052.creator: Kamalakar Karlapalem
arxiv-2312-00052.description: Abstract The efficiency of an AI system is contingent upon its ability to align with the specified requirements of a given task. However, the inherent complexity of tasks often introduces the potential for harmful implications or adverse actions. This note explores the critical concept of capability within AI systems, representing what the system is expected to deliver.

arxiv-2407-16586.title: Very-Large-Scale GPU-Accelerated Nuclear Gradient of Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory with Tamm–Dancoff Approximation and Range-Separated Hybrid Functionals
arxiv-2407-16586.creator: Inkoo Kim, Daun Jeong, Leah Weisburn, Alexandra Alexiu, Troy Van Voorhis, Young Min Rhee, Won-Joon Son, Hyung-Jin Kim, Jinkyu Yim, Sungmin Kim, Yeonchoo Cho, Inkook Jang, Seungmin Lee, Dae Sin Kim
arxiv-2407-16586.description: Abstract Modern graphics processing units (GPUs) provide an unprecedented level of computing power. In this study, we present a high-performance, multi-GPU implementation of the analytical nuclear gradient for Kohn–Sham time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT), employing the Tamm–Dancoff approximation (TDA) and Gaussian-type atomic orbitals as basis functions.

arxiv-2503-03888.title: AI for Scaling Legal Reform: Mapping and Redacting Racial Covenants in Santa Clara County
arxiv-2503-03888.creator: Faiz Surani Stanford University Mirac Suzgun Stanford University Vyoma Raman Stanford University Christopher D. Manning Stanford University Peter Henderson Princeton University Daniel E. Ho Stanford University Warning: This paper contains offensive racial terms from actual deed documents.
arxiv-2503-03888.description: Abstract Legal reform can be challenging in light of the volume, complexity, and interdependence of laws, codes, and records. One salient example of this challenge is the effort to restrict and remove racially restrictive covenants, clauses in property deeds that historically barred individuals of specific races from purchasing homes.

arxiv-2505-05185.title: Efficient Parallel Ising Samplers via Localization Schemes
arxiv-2505-05185.creator: Xiaoyu Chen, Hongyang Liu, Yitong Yin, Xinyuan Zhang
arxiv-2505-05185.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyu Chen, Hongyang Liu, Yitong Yin, Xinyuan Zhang. We introduce efficient parallel algorithms for sampling from the Gibbs distribution and estimating the partition function of Ising models. These algorithms achieve parallel efficiency, with polylogarithmic depth and polynomial total work, and are applicable to Ising models in the following regimes: (1) Ferromagnetic Ising models with external fields; (2) Ising models with interaction matrix J J of operator norm ‖ J ‖ 2 < 1 \|J\|_{2}<1 .

arxiv-2509-16879.creator: Yan-Li Wang, Shu-Ting Cai, Yu-Kuo Hsiao
arxiv-2509-16879.description: Abstract We investigate two-body non-leptonic D → S ​ S D\to SS weak decays, where S S denotes a light scalar meson such as a 0 / a 0 ​ ( 980 ) a_{0}/a_{0}(980) , f 0 / f 0 ​ ( 980 ) f_{0}/f_{0}(980) , or σ 0 / f 0 ​ ( 500 ) \sigma_{0}/f_{0}(500) .

arxiv-2511-22093.title: Characterizing Binary Black Hole Subpopulations in GWTC-4 with Binned Gaussian Processes: On the Origins of the 35 ​ M ⊙ 35M_{\odot} Peak.
arxiv-2511-22093.creator: Omkar Sridhar, Anarya Ray, Vicky Kalogera
arxiv-2511-22093.description: Abstract Understanding the astrophysical origins of binary black holes requires accurate and flexible modeling of multi-dimensional population properties. In this paper, using a data-driven framework based on binned Gaussian processes, we characterize the joint distribution of BBH primary masses, mass ratios, and effective inspiral spins.

arxiv-2601-01779.title: Machine learning modularity
arxiv-2601-01779.creator: Yi Fan, ​​, Vishnu Jejjala, ​​, Yang Lei
arxiv-2601-01779.description: Abstract Based on a transformer based sequence-to-sequence architecture combined with a dynamic batching algorithm, this work introduces a machine learning framework for automatically simplifying complex expressions involving multiple elliptic Gamma functions, including the q q - θ \theta function and the elliptic Gamma function.

arxiv-2601-08145.title: Light Nuclei embedded in a Nuclear Medium: Clustering and Mott Transitions
arxiv-2601-08145.creator: Qi Meng, Chang Xu
arxiv-2601-08145.description: Abstract The clustering of nucleons is a fundamental phenomenon with broad implications for nuclear physics and astrophysics. In this work, we employ a microscopic in-medium few-body approach to systematically investigate the formation and dissolution of light clusters (deuteron, H 3 \rm{{}^{3}H} , He 3 \rm{{}^{3}He} , α \alpha -particle) embedded in nuclear medium.

pmc-10641730.title: CAR-T cells and CAR-Tregs targeting conventional type-1 dendritic cell suppress experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis
pmc-10641730.creator: Cody D. Moorman, Sherman Yu, Carlos G. Briseno, Hyewon Phee, Anupama Sahoo, Ambika Ramrakhiani, Ashutosh Chaudhry
pmc-10641730.description: Conventional type 1 dendritic cells (DC1) contribute to the development of pathogenic T helper type 1 (Th1) cells in part via the production of the proinflammatory cytokine interleukin-12. Thus, depletion of DC1 has the potential to dampen autoimmune responses. Here, we developed X-C motif chemokine receptor 1 (XCR1)-specific chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cells and CAR-Tregs that specifically targeted DC1.

pmc-10757565.title: Leveraging monitoring, evaluation, and learning to scale the Enabling Inclusion® program for children with disabilities in India and globally
pmc-10757565.creator: Marie Brien, Franzina Coutinho, Dinesh Krishna, Lotte van der Haar, Joost de Laat, Sankara Raman Srinivasan, Navamani Venkatachalapathy
pmc-10757565.description: IntroductionChildren with disabilities in low- and middle-income countries face many challenges and lack adequate services, including access to rehabilitation professionals. To address this lack of access, Amar Seva Sangam Ayikudy (ASSA), a non-governmental organization (NGO) in India, designed a technology-leveraged rehabilitation program called Enabling Inclusion® (EI®), and implemented it in one state (Tamil Nadu, India) before scaling it.

pmc-11251705.title: Post-acquisition standardization of positron emission tomography images
pmc-11251705.creator: Aliasghar Mortazi, Jayaram K. Udupa, Dewey Odhner, Yubing Tong, Drew A. Torigian
pmc-11251705.description: PurposeTissue radiotracer activity measured from positron emission tomography (PET) images is an important biomarker that is clinically utilized for diagnosis, staging, prognostication, and treatment response assessment in patients with cancer and other clinical disorders. Using PET image values to define a normal range of metabolic activity for quantification purposes is challenging due to variations in patient-related factors and technical factors.

pmc-11354763.title: The Regulation of MicroRNA-21 by Interleukin-6 and Its Role in the Development of Fibrosis in Endometriotic Lesions
pmc-11354763.creator: Maria Ariadna Ochoa Bernal, Yong Song, Niraj Joshi, Gregory W. Burns, Emmanuel N. Paul, Erin Vegter, Samantha Hrbek, Lorenzo F. Sempere, Asgerally T. Fazleabas
pmc-11354763.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Endometriosis is one of the most common causes of chronic pelvic pain and infertility that affects 10% of women of reproductive age. It is currently defined as the presence of endometrial epithelial and stromal cells at ectopic sites; however, advances in endometriosis research have some authors believing that endometriosis should be re-defined as “a fibrotic condition in which endometrial stroma and epithelium can be identified”. microRNAs (miRNAs) are regulatory molecules that potentially play a role in endometriotic lesion development.

pmc-11465102.creator: Aleksi Hamina, Heidi Taipale, Johannes Lieslehto, Markku Lähteenvuo, Antti Tanskanen, Ellenor Mittendorfer-Rutz, Jari Tiihonen

pmc-12413144.title: Extracting Clinical Guideline Information Using Two Large Language Models: Evaluation Study
pmc-12413144.creator: Hsing-Yu Hsu, Lu-Wen Chen, Wan-Tseng Hsu, Yow-Wen Hsieh, Shih-Sheng Chang, Andrew Coristine
pmc-12413144.description: BackgroundThe effective implementation of personalized pharmacogenomics (PGx) requires the integration of released clinical guidelines into decision support systems to facilitate clinical applications. Large language models (LLMs) can be valuable tools for automating information extraction and updates.ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess the effectiveness of repeated cross-comparisons and an agreement-threshold strategy in 2 advanced LLMs as supportive tools for updating information.

pmc-12568035.title: Intelligent Classification of Urban Noise Sources Using TinyML: Towards Efficient Noise Management in Smart Cities
pmc-12568035.creator: Maykol Sneyder Remolina Soto, Brian Amaya Guzmán, Pedro Antonio Aya-Parra, Oscar J Perdomo, Mauricio Becerra-Fernandez, Jefferson Sarmiento-Rojas, Laszlo B Kish
pmc-12568035.description: Highlights What are the main findings? An efficient TinyML system was deployed for real-time, on-device classification of urban noise, achieving high accuracy (precision/recall up to 1.00).Heavy vehicles were identified as the most frequent noise sources, whereas aircraft generated the highest A-weighted sound pressure levels (La, max = 88.4 dB(A)), exceeding the local permissible limit by up to 18 dB(A).

pmc-12788329.title: Rate-Splitting-Based Resource Allocation in FANETs: Joint Optimization of Beam Direction, Node Pairing, Power and Time Slot
pmc-12788329.creator: Fukang Zhao, Chuang Song, Xu Li, Ying Liu, Yanan Liang
pmc-12788329.description: Directional flying ad hoc networks (FANETs) equipped with phased array antennas are pivotal for applications demanding high-capacity, low-latency communications. While directional beamforming extends the communication range, it necessitates the intricate joint optimization of the beam direction, power, and time-slot scheduling under hardware constraints.

pmc-13205009.description: Simple SummaryNon-melanoma head and neck skin cancers are the most common cancers in the head and neck region. pmc-13349176.title: Validating a novel driving simulation-based MWT against the standard MWT in an OSA-cohort challenged by CPAP-withdrawal (DS-MWT2) – Protocol for a monocentric, controlled, randomized, crossover trial
pmc-13349176.creator: Veronika Gambin, Nan Li, Esther Irene Schwarz, Kristina Keller, Stefan Lakämper, Christian Veauthier, Christian Veauthier, Christian Veauthier
pmc-13349176.description: BackgroundExcessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) is a major yet under-recognized contributor to road traffic accidents. Traditional diagnostic tools, such as the Maintenance of Wakefulness Test (MWT), assess wakefulness under passive conditions but may not accurately reflect real-world driving risks. To address this gap, we have piloted a Driving Simulation–based MWT (DS-MWT), designed to evaluate sleepiness in an ecologically valid driving scenario.

pmc-13466615.title: Comparative Evaluation of Aqueous Toluidine Blue Stain and Conventional Papanicolaou Stain in Cervicovaginal Smear

pmc-13466615.description: Background:Cervical cancer is the fourth most frequently diagnosed cancer. In India, cervical cancer is the second most diagnosed cancer among women following breast cancer. Early detection of precursor lesions of cervical cancer on cervical cytology by a screening program remarkably reduces the death rate.
